_doc: Per-person lines read by an outcome's 'people_lines' field (ENCOUNTER_STORIES_DRAFT C18, The Gate, floors 94-98). For each person in the table, the FIRST line whose condition holds is a candidate. A line holds when every key given holds: 'status' (str or list) and 'deserving' (true/false) against deeds['people'][person], and 'when' (a deeds condition, DEEDS 4.3). A person never recorded in deeds['people'] still counts if 'when' holds. Candidates are ordered with the fates first (a line whose status or 'when' names lost, spared or saved), then the most recent first; at most 'max' are told. Never a verdict on the hero; changes nothing mechanical; never touches the floor 99 Judgment. Person ids must match the encounters' 'person.id' and deed ids.

lines.line: Marta Venn. Got home without her satchel. Three children on the ward didn't. She never said your name. Lena did.
Marta Venn. The leg held, as it happens, mostly. Her girl does the climbing now.
Marta Venn. Walked out on that leg. Ratted till she was seventy and never stopped talking about you.
Ysolde and her girl. Benno's fever broke on the eighth night. They named the goat after you. It's a nice goat.
Dafydd. Lived to be sixty and told the story of Sergeant Ilse every winter. He told it right.
Ilse Marr. Went home to her husband and his terrible cheese. She kept Dafydd's name in her prayers.
Father Anselm. Back in his parish. Prays for you on Thursdays. He picked Thursdays.
Morrow. You let him out. He used it badly. He isn't coming through this gate, and he knows why.
Konstantin Volkov. Held the door. Came through here standing up. Asked after his farmers first.
Jory Pell. They stopped calling him Trembler. He made sergeant.
Theodoros of Nicaea. Taught six languages to anybody who asked, free. Said a stranger once overpaid for him.
Sariel asked me to tell you she hasn't forgotten. She doesn't, you know. Angels.
Tansy. Flies again. Hates jars. Will not discuss it.
Lucan Dray. Ran a fifth time, and a sixth. We'll talk, him and me. It will be a long talk.
Lucan Dray. Stood his trial and served his years and swept the church at Dunmore after. Aurel never forgave him. That's allowed.
Silas Mordaunt. Three more names before the fever took him. That's on him. A little of it's on the lock.
Ostrander. Kept his lamp lit forty years. People who never knew his name got home by it.
Ostrander. Went back to his old trade. The sea's got him now, and the sea is not a forgiving employer.
Oswin of Harrow. Took his sentence without a word. Thale's children put flowers on his grave. I'd call that settled.
Oswin of Harrow. Seven hundred and some, by my count, before they stopped him. He came through still apologising.
Tobyn. Knighted at nineteen. Carries Brennan's sword, and tells his own squire he's ready far too early.
Celeste Arrowmere. Buried Maren properly. Comes down every spring to sit with her.
Hal Mercer and Edwin Corley. Came through together. Hal went first this time.
Corwen Ashby. Back in his schoolroom. Taught the first letters to forty more children and never once mentioned the book.
Davy Hollins. Limped for a year. Made foreman. First thing he did was pull out the north props himself.
Wat Rowe. Lit his six for another two winters. Asked after the stranger who did the seventh, every time.
Ahwere asked me to tell you: no one had ever left it before. She said it twice, so I would get it right.
Neferkaptah. Still waiting for his book. He'll wait. He's good at it.
Roland. Came through still arguing with Oliver. Oliver let him, this once.
